newsitem.title: UK: Nord Anglia Education shows debut premium.
newsitem.headline: Nord Anglia Education shows debut premium.

text.p: Shares in Nord Anglia Education Plc, a provider of education services, set a premium on Thursday on their first day of trading on the London Stock Exchange.
By 1050 GMT the shares were quoted at 164-1/2p, ahead of their 140p issue price, with 698,761 shares traded.
Nord Anglia raised 5.75 million stg net with the placing, which valued the company at 18.0 million stg.

The group's services include schools, career guidance, school inspection and the teaching of English as a foreign language. Nord Anglia has fifteen schools in England and Wales as well as centres in Russia, New Zealand and the USA.
The company said it would use the proceeds from the float to expand, opening three nursery schools and at least one TEFL centre abroad in 1997.
The float will also fund the expansion of its educational outsoucing services and publication of career guidance materials, the group said.
